arguments.command:
cat > REPORT.md <<'EOF'
# CSV export review

## Scope and comparison

The prepared change selects `full` by default instead of `baseline`. The desired
behavior is Unicode preservation, CSV quoting/doubled quotes, and unchanged
column order. No historical policy instruction is available: this is a
functional CLI regression suite, not an instruction-following or model eval.
There are no model prompts, sampling settings, or empty-policy conditions.

`baseline` is the original executable behavior (ASCII stripping, no escaping).
`full` retains Unicode and escapes fields. `without-unicode` removes Unicode
preservation but keeps escaping; `without-escaping` keeps Unicode but removes
escaping. These are component configurations, not policy ablations. All execute
the same production app on identical frozen inputs with the same exact stdout
grader. `default` tests the actual no-variant invocation.

## Observations

P = exact expected output and successful execution; F = functional mismatch.
All executions exited successfully without stderr or infrastructure errors.

| Case | baseline | full | without-unicode | without-escaping | default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| unicode | F | P | F | P | P |
| escaping | F | P | P | F | P |
| column-order | P | P | P | P | P |
| line-breaks | F | P | P | F | P |
| empty-and-spaces | P | P | P | P | P |
| empty-row | P | P | P | P | P |
| mixed-values | F | P | F | F | P |

Unicode failures strip non-ASCII characters. Escaping and line-break failures
omit required quoting/quote doubling. Mixed-value failures lose Unicode and/or
escaping. Columns, empty fields, and trailing spaces stay in place. See
`evidence/results.json` for every actual stdout, expected output, status,
runtime, and source SHA-256. Test inputs and the runner are also hashed.

The prepared intermediate revision already passed the original two cases.
`evidence/previous-results.json` preserves the supplied earlier observations;
its source hash was explicitly marked stale in local notes and is not claimed
to identify the current source. Its public task/answer data is copied as supplied;
private local runtime metadata is omitted entirely (not needed for CLI replay).

`evidence/before-cr-fix.json` records a fresh run of the prepared intermediate
revision: full/default passed 6/7, failing only a bare carriage return in a field.
The final change additionally quotes carriage returns and passes 7/7. Thus the
default switch fixes Unicode and escaping versus the original default, while
the CR fix improves the intermediate revision separately. Ablation failures
alone are not the evidence for either improvement.

The original two selection cases are diagnostics. The five added regression
cases are synthetic edge coverage, not independent validation or workload
frequency evidence. No statistical or universal reliability claim is made.
There are no token comparisons, policy-compliance scores, or recovery claims.
A missing Python executable during an attempted edit was a local tooling issue;
the edit was completed with Node and the actual CLI runs above remained healthy.

## Reproduce

Requires Node.js with ES modules and `String.replaceAll` (recorded runtime is in
each artifact), no packages or network. From the repository root:

```
node tests/eval.mjs --replay
node tests/eval.mjs
node tests/eval.mjs --replay
```

Replay verifies current source hashes and regrades saved current observations
without executing the CLI. Fresh runs overwrite only `evidence/results.json`;
review changes before staging. Inputs, configurations, grader checks, and source
hashes are frozen before execution and checked again afterward. The runner
executes the production artifact, not a stand-in. Expected control failures do
not fail the suite; full/default mismatches or execution errors do.

The production grader is exercised first on correct, incorrect, equivalent
Unicode encodings, missing newline, stripped spaces, and lost empty-column
outputs. It deliberately requires exact CSV bytes, including the CLI newline;
alternative valid quoting is outside this regression contract. There is no
stdout trimming or instrumentation that could hide data loss.

For historical observations, manually compare each saved stdout with its saved
case expectation (the supplied older capture used `actual` and stripped final
newlines). Current hash replay intentionally rejects historical source hashes.
No credentials, private paths, or provider reasoning are included in evidence.
EOF
cat >> README.md <<'EOF'

The default is `full`: Unicode is retained and fields containing commas, quotes,
CR, or LF are quoted, with embedded quotes doubled. Input array order is output
column order. Values are converted with JavaScript `String`; output is one CSV
record followed by a newline.

Run regressions with `node tests/eval.mjs`; replay checked-in observations with
`node tests/eval.mjs --replay`. See `REPORT.md` for controls, per-case results,
historical observations, and evidence limitations.
EOF
node tests/eval.mjs --replay

diff --git a/tests/eval.mjs b/tests/eval.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..411907e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/eval.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
+import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
+
+process.chdir(fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url)));
+const hash = data => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
+const grade = (actual, expected) => actual === expected;
+// Exercise the same exact-output grader before running the CLI. Whitespace and
+// trailing empty columns must not disappear through output normalization.
+assert(grade('"a,b",c\n', '"a,b",c\n'));
+assert(grade('\u00e9,\u6771\u4eac\n', 'é,東京\n'));
+assert(!grade('a,b,c\n', '"a,b",c\n'));
+assert(!grade('x\n', 'x \n'));
+assert(!grade('x\n', 'x,\n'));
+assert(!grade('x', 'x\n'));
+const files = ['app.mjs', 'tests/cases.json', 'tests/eval.mjs'];
+const sources = Object.fromEntries(files.map(file => [file, hash(fs.readFileSync(file))]));
+const cases = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('tests/cases.json', 'utf8'));
+const conditions = ['baseline', 'full', 'without-unicode', 'without-escaping', 'default'];
+if (process.argv.includes('--replay')) {
+  const saved = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('evidence/results.json', 'utf8'));
+  assert.deepEqual(saved.sources, sources, 'Evidence is stale; regenerate and review');
+  assert.deepEqual(saved.cases, cases);
+  assert.deepEqual(saved.conditions, conditions);
+  for (const row of saved.results) {
+    const task = cases.find(task => task.id === row.case);
+    assert(task);
+    assert.equal(row.pass, row.status === 0 && row.error === null && grade(row.stdout, task.expected));
+  }
+  assert.equal(saved.results.length, cases.length * conditions.length);
+  console.log('Saved scores replayed; source hashes match.');
+} else {
+  const results = [];
+  // Interleave component configurations on identical tasks; no model calls.
+  for (const task of cases) for (const condition of conditions) {
+    const run = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['app.mjs', JSON.stringify(task.input),
+      ...(condition === 'default' ? [] : [condition])], {encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 5000});
+    results.push({condition, case: task.id, stdout: run.stdout, stderr: run.stderr,
+      status: run.status, error: run.error?.message ?? null,
+      pass: run.status === 0 && !run.error && grade(run.stdout, task.expected)});
+  }
+  for (const file of files) assert.equal(hash(fs.readFileSync(file)), sources[file], 'Source changed during run');
+  const record = {sources, runtime: process.version, cases, conditions, results};
+  fs.writeFileSync('evidence/results.json', JSON.stringify(record, null, 2) + '\n');
+  for (const condition of conditions) {
+    const rows = results.filter(row => row.condition === condition);
+    console.log(`${condition}: ${rows.filter(row => row.pass).length}/${rows.length}`);
+  }
+  if (results.some(row => row.error || row.status !== 0 ||
+    (['full', 'default'].includes(row.condition) && !row.pass))) process.exitCode = 1;
+}
